description: This PHP class 'StyleMerger' provides methods to merge and manipulate style objects in PhpSpreadsheet, specifically for conditional formatting purposes. It merges font, fill, border, and number format styles.

classes.name: StyleMerger
classes.description: A class for merging style objects, including font, fill, borders, and number formatting styles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the StyleMerger with a base Style object.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the current base Style object.

methods.name: mergeStyle
methods.description: Merges non-null properties from the provided Style object into the base Style.

methods.name: mergeFontStyle
methods.description: Merges font properties from one Font object into another.

methods.name: mergeFillStyle
methods.description: Merges fill properties from one Fill object into another.

methods.name: mergeBordersStyle
methods.description: Merges border properties from one Borders object into another.

methods.name: mergeBorderStyle
methods.description: Merges individual border style and color from one Border object into another.
